name: Gryth Thurden

narrative.details:
Here are the honorary picks for Brock's students.  If you've already been to Thelsamar, then you should fly a gryphon back there!

Take the picks to our gryphon master, Gryth Thurden, and speak with him about a ride back to Thelsamar.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: You have to get these to Thelsamar, eh? That won't be a problem. As long as you've already been to Thelsamar and spoken to Thorgrum Borrelson, then you can take one of my gryphons back to him.
narrative.requestItemsText: You look like you have somewhere to go. Need one of my gryphons?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests at level 10, 1,890 XP in all.

quests.name: Honor Students
quests.objectiveText: Bring Brock's List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Ride to Ironforge
quests.objectiveText: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

quests.name: Gryth Thurden
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

quests.name: Return to Brock
quests.objectiveText: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.
